dedupe_keys.name: north rhine westphalia central water supply installations wasserversorgungsanlagen nrw

description: LANUK, the environment agency of North Rhine-Westphalia, produced this CSV of master data for the central water supply installations in the state: waterworks as defined in the Drinking Water Ordinance, including their abstraction and network, that supply at least 10 m3 of drinking water a day or at least 50 people. Coverage is North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. The data are free under the Data Licence Germany Zero 2.0 as a zipped CSV and an Atom feed, last updated on 26 February 2026. Caveats: to protect critical infrastructure the UTM coordinates are anonymised by replacing their last two digits with X, so locations are only accurate to about 100 m. Simulation uses: locating waterworks for hazard exposure and supply planning in a German state. Related records: the European urban waste water treatment plants (data-uwwtd-treatment-plants).
